answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can transact. The stake earns a reputation pulse only after sustained, useful work over weeks, and it decays if the agent goes idle or is flagged. A sybil operator must fund a separate stake for each identity and keep each one active, so the echo of cheap copies collapses: creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand locked deposits, and one proven fraud slashes the whole stake.
